name: ESP32-S31-Korvo-1
description: The ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 is a multimedia development board based on the ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 module, targeting smart audio and HMI applications. The mainboard integrates a dual-microphone array, an ES8389 audio codec with dual speaker outputs, an addressable RGB LED, a microSD card slot, a camera connector and four function buttons (PLAY, SET, VOL- and VOL+). The display is provided by the separate ESP32-S3-LCD-EV-Board-SUB3 subboard, an 800x480 RGB LCD with a GT1151 capacitive touch panel, attached through the board's LCD connector.
shortDescription: LVGL ported to the ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 using Espressif BSP.
getStartedInstructions:
1. Attach the ESP32-S3-LCD-EV-Board-SUB3 LCD subboard to the LCD connector.
2. Set up [ESP-IDF](https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/esp32s31/get-started/index.html). ESP32-S31 is currently a preview target, so the master branch of ESP-IDF is required.
3. `idf.py --preview set-target esp32s31`
4. `idf.py -p <COMx or /dev/ttyx> flash monitor`
